outreach_text:
Hello Anxious Cakes,

I'm Amala from MultiMax. We build affordable websites for local businesses. I came across your custom cakes, cupcakes and cake pops through your public creator profile and prepared an independent website concept for Anxious Cakes in Norfolk.

I found your Facebook presence but did not identify a dedicated official website in the sources I checked. This preview is an unsolicited concept, not an official site or a claim of your endorsement. The cake illustrations are concept artwork, not photos of your products.

Live preview:
https://amalraj020-a11y.github.io/10am-office-work/websites/anxious-cakes-norfolk/

Source and credits:
https://github.com/amalraj020-a11y/10am-office-work/tree/2b52ac5ba1c9782a11751345d13f4c684d0fa9cb/websites/anxious-cakes-norfolk

I've attached two current screenshots, one desktop and one mobile. You can also view them here:
https://amalraj020-a11y.github.io/10am-office-work/work/screenshots/anxious-cakes-norfolk-desktop.png
https://amalraj020-a11y.github.io/10am-office-work/work/screenshots/anxious-cakes-norfolk-mobile.png

If this direction feels right for your bakery, reply and we can discuss your ideas and a small, agreed budget. Any backend or database features would be optional later work, separately agreed; the current concept does not process orders or payments.

If you're not interested, just let me know and I won't follow up.

Amala
MultiMax
